scope: S02 independent public-site truth data only; 3 sites / 9 source pages / 9 public tasks

environment.context: Fresh anonymous browser contexts; read-only public-page navigation; no login, form entry, form submit, application, download or payment.

method: Human review of rendered visible-control extracts, raw/absolute hrefs, safe labels/attributes and ancestor context. Screenshot review performed on gov-search, agency-faq, library-search and library-help. National Library required primitive-string extracts after object-returning evaluation gave undefined. No classifier or ranker was inspected and no product evaluation was run before the truth records.
sourceEvidencePolicy: Only selected public controls and relevant context are retained here. Fixtures are small manually reconstructed menu subsets; full site HTML, script bundles, editable input values and authentication data are not retained as evidence.

otherExploration.observation: Public rendered controls observed; many use script-backed empty hrefs. Not selected after 국민안전24 provided stable public links. Not a blocked site or product failure.

otherExploration.observation: Exploratory direct URL was not found; this does not establish the entire site is unavailable. Not selected.

Initial object-returning page.evaluate result was undefined. A separate default urllib request failed certificate-chain verification (CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED / self-signed certificate in certificate chain). Normal Playwright title/body locator and primitive-string extracts then verified public pages without disabling certificate checks or changing security settings.
otherExploration.result: Resolved observation-method limitation; original preferred library retained. Not a site access failure or substitution.
